system.effect: Effect: You can see through Illusions. This means you can spot Illusions from the @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.fzzVyOiDHNP0Aiuf]{Illusionist} capability, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.hm6xNix5GQLmHa2r]{Illusion} Ability, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.feats.Item.uDOEW8x6gNxw5rLf]{Genjutsu} Feature as being fake. You are immune to Moves with the @CompSearch[Moves keywords=Illusion]{Illusion} keyword, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.BHmRIX70tqHROfdN]{Double Team} cannot be activated against you, and you bypass @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.IGk8nNBogMKp3seI]{Substitutes}. As a Standard Action, you can create a Burst 4, dispelling all Illusion effects within. Disguises and Illusions: Disguises in general refer to things with physical components; a mundane disguise would be the kind with props and fake moustaches and the like. An example of a magical disguise would be a Ditto’s @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.pN7pRkPFKKPF9vPi]{Transformation}. Illusions are magical effects, such as the Move Double Team, Substitute, or the Illusion Ability.
